title: Framework (fd.c): CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_DO_KDF handler
description:
Implement ioctl_do_kdf() in src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c.

Steps:
1. copy_from_user the kdf_op struct
2. Validate: algo non-empty, out_algo non-empty, out_keylen > 0 and <= 64, salt_len <= SALT_MAXLEN, info_len <= INFO_MAXLEN
3. For PBKDF2: enforce iterations >= 1000, return -EINVAL if less
4. Resolve IKM: if ikm_fd >= 0, fget() the KEY fd and extract key bytes; else use state->write_buf (data from prior write() calls)
5. Look up provider for out_algo (the algorithm the key will be used for)
6. Allocate out_key[64] on stack (kernel memory only)
7. Call ops->kdf(ctx, algo, ikm, ikm_len, salt, salt_len, info, info_len, iterations, out_key, out_keylen)
8. On success: promote this fd to KEY fd by calling key_import logic with out_key bytes
9. memzero_explicit(out_key, sizeof(out_key)) unconditionally
10. Zeroize write_buf if used for IKM/password
11. Return 0 on success; fd is now a KEY fd

Thread safety: hold state->lock throughout. fget/fput key fd outside lock to avoid deadlock.
